OUR WELFARE IN ACTION

Together in unity.

We stand together in both difficult and happy times, celebrating one another’s joys and offering care, compassion and practical support when challenges arise. Through unity and shared responsibility, no member should feel alone.

WHO WE ARE

A shared commitment
to community progress.

I.W.D.A. brings people together around the values of unity, mutual support, responsible leadership and sustainable development.

We aim to nurture a responsible, united and empowered community where members work together, care for one another and contribute to positive social and economic progress.

RESPECT & PRIVACY

Your information deserves care.

IWDA should collect only information needed to respond to enquiries and manage membership applications. Personal details should be accessed only by authorized representatives, kept secure, and retained only as needed for the stated purpose. Before launch, IWDA should confirm its privacy contact, retention practice and applicable privacy obligations.
